constraints.field: NLP combined with Graph Neural Networks
constraints.hardware: one consumer GPU, 8 GB VRAM (or a free cloud notebook)

method: Each criterion is scored 0-5 with evidence. score_percent is the weighted share earned on scored criteria only; score_range shows the total if unscored criteria were 0 or 5. Any blocker removes a candidate from the ranking no matter how high its other scores are.
